Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: If a recipient wishes to use the message replay service, they must first be authenticated by sending a Login message to the relevant replay server.

Field.Name: username
Field.Description: As assigned by Aquis for the recipient

Field.Name: password
Field.Description: As assigned by Aquis for the recipient

Message.Name: Replay Request Message
Message.Description: The recipient sends a Replay Request message to request a particular message or range of messages from the replay server.

Field.Name: beginSeqNo
Field.Description: Stream seqNo of first message requested

Field.Name: endSeqNo
Field.Description: Stream seqNo of last message requested

Message.Name: Replay Response Message
Message.Description: Aquis will send a Replay Response message to the recipient to acknowledge a successful Login or to report problems with a Resend Request.

Field.Name: responseCode
Field.Description: Possible values are: 0 = Login successful, 1 = Bad beginSeqNo in Resend Request, 2 = Bad endSeqNo in Resend Request
